title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a BST
microsoftNote: Walk down from the root; split point is the LCA. p and q are values.
statement:
Given a BST `root` and two node values `p` and `q` that exist in the tree, return the value of their lowest common ancestor.

The LCA is the lowest node that has both `p` and `q` as descendants (a node can be a descendant of itself).
constraints: The number of nodes is in [2, 10^5].
p and q exist in the tree.
editorial: If both p and q are < root, go left. Both > root, go right. Else root is the split.
